title: The Man Who Found a Penguin

lines.text: One morning, a man was walking down the street,
Just a penguin. Standing there. Looking at him.
Officer! What do I do with this penguin?
The next day, the officer saw them again.
Same man. Same penguin. Holding hands. Eating ice cream.
I told you to take him to the zoo!
Today, we're going to the movies.
